audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p3: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Medicine 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Paediatrics 12, Psychiatry 12), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3-L5 tier, since the closed legacy L1-L2 inventory of about 28 to 31 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.3 per cent L3, 44.2 to 44.3 per cent L4 and 6.4 to 6.5 per cent L5, so L5 sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated. The L3 and L4 deficits were tied to within 0.05 percentage points across all eight remaining cells, so the tie was broken toward the lower-total topics per the equal-module-balance directive, giving 26 L3 and 24 L4 and zero L1 or L2. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity 1.33 across all 50 with the correct option the longest in 20; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option, no follow local guidelines non-options and no stem carries more than two chained pertinent-negative closures.
